sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: *Milyen?* asks what someone is like, and an adjective answers. For he or she there is no verb: *Ő magas.* With several people the adjective takes *-k* after a linking vowel by harmony: *Ők magasak*, *Ők kedvesek*. Before a noun the adjective never changes: *egy magas férfi*. *Nagyon* (very) goes right before the adjective, and *és* (and) and *de* (but) join descriptions.
The *-k* only appears when the adjective stands alone after the noun: *Ők magasak*. In front of a noun it stays the same: *a magas fiúk*, where the *-k* belongs to *fiúk*.
